lines.1: Ryugu, the executive committee's building, had two floors.
lines.2: To be blunt, the first floor was a storeroom.
lines.3: It was piled high with all sorts of things used for school events.
lines.4: 「Here we are. This is the workplace.」
lines.5: 「What?! This is practically a whole house!」
lines.6: 「Yoppi and I have made various improvements.」
lines.8: 「That was always here. Apparently they used to hold tea parties often.」
lines.10: 「There's a sofa here, and a computer in the back.」
lines.11: 「The computer contains student council data. Do not touch it until you formally join.」
lines.12: 「You can see the whole ocean! This feels great.」
lines.14: 「Whoa, there are magazines and manga too. You do whatever you want here!」
lines.15: 「Princess, those times you're missing during class...」
lines.16: 「That's right. I come sleep here. No teachers visit.」
lines.17: 「That's a sweet deal... Would we be allowed to use it too?」
lines.18: 「Sure, on one condition: don't get caught.」
lines.19: 「Wait, but don't you sleep here too, Princess?」
lines.20: 「I sleep in a hammock behind a locked door in the room farther back.」
